title: Planner: Add times to task start, finish, and due dates
description: Add specific times to task start, finish, and due dates. Define a plan’s time zone and working hours to automatically provide default task times and choose whether to view times in the plan’s time zone or your local time zone. This helps distributed teams coordinate effectively across time zones and keep deadlines clear.
